name: Mass Polymorph
oracle_text: Exile all creatures you control, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards. Put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.
blocked_sentences: Exile all creatures you control, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards. Put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.

needs.what: reveal_until with an amount: one reveal run that continues until N matching cards are revealed (N a value, here the number of creatures exiled by the preceding exile, e.g. a count over its `as` binding), puts all N onto the battlefield simultaneously, then shuffles the rest of the revealed cards into the library
needs.why_existing_wont_do: reveal_until stops at the first match and has no amount; wrapping it in repeat with rest_to_bottom false and a trailing shuffle would put the creatures onto the battlefield one at a time across separate reveals rather than all at once, which changes enters triggers and 'as enters' counts that see the other creatures entering
